mapper.sql: t.id, t.publisher_id, t.title, t.departure_code, t.departure, t.destination_code, t.destination, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.stops, t.meeting_areas, t.meeting_time, t.travel_mode, t.note, t.budget_min_cents, t.budget_max_cents, t.tags, t.capacity, t.joined_count, t.completed_at, t.cancelled_at, t.cancel_reason, t.cancel_note, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.ai_itinerary_id

choose.when: ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY t.start_date ASC, t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
